createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the connection, such as the length or quality of the relationship.

effectiveend.description: Enter the end date of the connection.

effectivestart.description: Enter the start date of the connection.

entityimage.description: The default image for the entity.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

ismaster.description: Indicates that this is the master record.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

record1objecttypecode.description: Shows the record type of the source record.

record2objecttypecode.description: Shows the record type of the target record.

statecode.description: Shows whether the connection is active or inactive.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the connection.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_record1id_value.description: Choose the primary account, contact, or other record involved in the connection.

_record1roleid_value.description: Choose the primary party's role or relationship with the second party.

_record2id_value.description: Select the secondary account, contact, or other record involved in the connection.

_record2roleid_value.description: Choose the secondary party's role or relationship with the primary party.

_relatedconnectionid_value.description: Unique identifier for the reciprocal connection record.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
